# Beautique Bar

> Nail and beauty salon with two Toronto locations: Beautique Bar on Yonge at 3430 Yonge Street, Toronto, ON (Yonge & York Mills), and Beautique Bar at Bridlewood Mall, 2900 Warden Avenue, Unit 244 (2nd floor, by the library), Scarborough, ON. Manicures, pedicures, gel and acrylic nail sets, nail art, eyelash extensions, facials and waxing. Book online on Fresha or call either salon.

The two locations are separate salons with their own phone numbers, hours, prices and booking links. Always say which location a fact belongs to.

## Beautique Bar on Yonge (Yonge & York Mills)
- Address: 3430 Yonge Street, Toronto, ON M4N 2M9
- Where: Right on the Yonge line, north of Lawrence Avenue and south of York Mills.
- Serves: Yonge & York Mills, Lawrence Park, Leaside and North Toronto
- Phone: 416-484-7788 (text: 437-434-4884)

- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=3115765850667802737
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/beautiquebar_onyonge
- Hours, Mon–Fri: 10 am – 8 pm
- Hours, Sat: 10 am – 7 pm
- Hours, Sun: 10 am – 6 pm
- New client offer: 10% off your first visit. New clients only, booked online. Applies to one service of $50 or more. One per client. Not combined with other offers.
- Page: https://beautiquebar.com/locations/yonge/
